a.lede: Redditor showcases a new quad 8-pin power-conversion kit for the 16-pin power connector on Nvidia GeForce RTX graphics cards.
a.title: Quad 8-pin mod protects the $8,500 RTX 5090 you can’t replace from melting

b.lede: Micro Center has reclassified Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics cards as 'Not Carried,' and almost all units are out of stock at its stores.
b.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 disappears from Micro Center amid rumors of a production halt
